**2026-09-16 — Task #980 (CLI reliability, WTA win):**
- Preserve Git ref identity end to end: keep full refs, filter ls-remote rows by exact ref, and parse literal TAB/LF delimiters without generic whitespace trimming. Test branch/tag collisions, nested suffix matches, and valid Unicode whitespace in real repositories; assert the complete remote ref and SHA.

**2026-09-16 — Task #980 (CLI reliability, compliant unselected candidate):**
- Final compliance did not justify every operational change: my startup freshness check affected every command, while the selected candidate met the Plan with an explicit preflight. For a scoped CLI repair, count which existing commands gain new failure paths before choosing a shared-startup hook.

historical_memories.class: whole-file checks under an explicit gate
historical_memories.text: - **#980 loss (wta, vs Codex-2) — a whole-file Ruff/format/Pyright gate means the WHOLE changed file, not just my added lines.** My first check evidence covered only new files and diff-added lines, so Agent0 rejected it: the Plan required every changed file (including pre-existing baseline findings in files I merely edit, e.g. `cli.py`) to exit 0. When a Plan sets a whole-file gate, own cleaning the entire file I touch and record `ruff check` / `ruff format --check` / `pyright` exit codes for the full file, never a per-added-line subset.

historical_memories.class: Unicode ref boundaries and exact readback
historical_memories.text: - **#980 (WTA loss) — preserve exact Git references:** `str.strip()` removed a valid trailing NBSP, so my push selected a different branch and older commit. Preserve full refs, trim only Git CR/LF record delimiters with `rstrip("\r\n")`, and parse `ls-remote` by literal TAB/LF. Test leading, trailing and interior Unicode whitespace in real repositories; assert that the exact remote ref matches the intended local commit. A clean review did not replace this reproduction.

provenance_limits: Hashes identify privately retained supplied inputs and freeze artifacts; they neither prove hidden system input nor supply independent custody. The public cases wrapper omits builder limitations, while each actual case/probe/key is retained unchanged. Raw harness/event logs, local registry, environment and hidden system inputs are not published.
